comments.author: frank
comments.body: `os.environ` and `print` in our codebase? This should use `settings.database_url` and the structured logger like everything else.

comments.author: carol
comments.body: It's a one-off under scripts/, run by hand from the bastion with a different DATABASE_URL (the snapshot, then prod). Importing app.config would pull in all the app settings and their validation.

comments.author: alice
comments.body: Fine for scripts/. The settings and logging rules are for app/. One-off scripts can use env vars and print; they're not deployed.

threads.rejection_reason: One-off scripts under scripts/ may use os.environ and print; the rules apply to app/.
